decision: The concrete v9 source-first, machine-transcript, separate-audio-consent and fixed local runtime design is coherent enough for a bounded native packet. This accepts design direction only, not dependency integration, implementation, runtime behavior or product voice completion.
review_evidence: Read final F0 independent review and the frozen native draft; compared architecture boundaries with accepted v8 vault and existing organization receipt/consent schema.

The native draft keeps full WAV bytes as vault authority and records a separate deterministic 16 kHz derivative, ASR operation, machine evidence and human correction. V9 fences all existing mutation paths and preserves v1-v8 bytes.

The status/recovery command now requires expectedVaultId and selected-vault/session validation before intent, stage, receipt or ASR disclosure. Text/photo consent cannot authorize audio; v3 audio_transcript binding and separate audio consent table/route keep purpose and epoch distinct while reusing the existing receipt store.

CPAL 0.18.2 documentation supports advertised input-config enumeration and input callbacks; Rubato 5 documentation describes Fft as the fixed-ratio offline resampler. Exact crate pins and MSRV remain build gates. The 120-second or 24-MiB PCM cap covers the stated supported rate/channel set at 48 kHz stereo with header and queue separately bounded.
Compared apps, services, packages, infra and tests with the accepted TEXT-FILE manifest: zero product-file changes before dispatch.
implementation_conditions: Verify exact crate archive hashes, lockfile resolution, compiler compatibility and supported Windows input formats before integrating dependencies; unsupported devices fail clearly.
Generate golden derivative hashes for each supported rate/channel and chunk boundary; maintain independent full-original SHA-256 and journaled retry identities.

Add a small checked-in pinned asset manifest and build-time staging script. Keep runtime/model/DLL/license artifacts ignored, verify all hashes before bundling, and do not hardcode the F0 tooling path or download on first run.

Check the packaged binary's required CPU features before launch, or prove a baseline fallback. Keep the RMS <= 5 gate limited to tested near-zero input and distinguish failed/UNKNOWN audio from eligible unreviewed machine transcription.

Validate exact v9 source/provenance consistency, authorization before status disclosure, source-first commit, correction precedence, consent fencing, current/history Ask eligibility and v1-v8 byte replay on the implemented candidate. Independent exact-candidate review remains required.
authority_boundary: No private audio, live provider, paid call, activation, deployment, push or merge is authorized by this design gate. Installed Recall Record/Stop, semantic organization, Ask and playback remain open.
